comment: The tools setup downloads, each at one exact version, checked by size and SHA-256 (fetch.py). An entry whose sha256 is null is not pinned yet and fetch.py refuses it. Sizes are the publishers'; each sum was measured on a first download and checked against the publisher's own checksum where it lists one.

tools.name: python-embed
tools.why: Runs the lifters and this setup.

tools.name: llvm-win64
tools.why: Compiles and links the game part: clang, lld-link and clang's headers from LLVM 22.1.8 (docs/86).
tools.checked: made by the LLVM archive workflow (run 39870384825) from LLVM's own clang+llvm-22.1.8-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.tar.xz after its size, SHA-256, attestation and GPG signature passed; the asset's size and SHA-256 read back from the release, 2026-10-22

tools.name: python-linux
tools.why: Runs the lifters and this setup on Linux, where python.org has no embeddable package (docs/87).
tools.checked: size and SHA-256 from the release's asset list (its digest field), matched by a download, 2026-10-24

tools.name: llvm-linux-x64
tools.why: Compiles and links the game part on Linux: clang, ld.lld and clang's headers from LLVM 22.1.8 (docs/86).
tools.checked: made by LLVM archive run https://github.com/JonathanDC64/DemonsSoulsRecomp/actions/runs/40160368044 from LLVM-22.1.8-Linux-X64.tar.xz (size, SHA-256, attestation and GPG signature checked), 2026-10-25
